description: Attempt to install the Agent Plugins bundle into Antigravity CLI from a local path.
why: ADR-0045 recorded Antigravity's manifest schema as closed and DIFFERENT from the Agent Plugins one, and its file shapes as unspecified. This scenario exists to turn that into a measurement: if `agy plugin install` accepts the bundle, the deferred variant is unnecessary; if it rejects it, the rejection message is the spec. SKIPPED with reason when the CLI is absent. Extended 2026-09-10 with the R14 Claude-format probe.

steps.why: antigravity.google/docs/cli/plugins: `agy plugin install /path/to/local/plugin`. Either outcome is information; the stderr is captured in the report.

R14 probe, part 1: the Claude-format plugin, built fresh. Superpowers' README documents `agy plugin install <github url>` of a .claude-plugin repository, which suggests Antigravity loads Claude-format plugins - unverified against Antigravity's own docs (read 2026-09-10, which mention no such compatibility).

R14 probe, part 2: if Antigravity accepts the Claude plugin, the deferred variant (ADR-0045) collapses to a marketplace entry; if it rejects both bundles, the rejection messages are the spec for the variant. Either outcome is information.
